title: Odetah Camping Resort

services.name: RV Site
services.desc: Our passion is to provide our guests an incredible camping experience. Odetah embodies camping at its very core and caters to all levels of campers. Whether pitching a tent for the first time or a seasoned veteran driving a Class A motorhome, Odetah caters to your every need. Our sites are as unique as Odetah itself and offer many options including waterfront sites, private locations and the perfect group camping areas. Our campers can relax, refresh and retreat anywhere within our picturesque wooded hillside. The Odetah staff will provide a first class camping experience to you, your family and friends.
